title: Component notation for normalized compact-support composition and projection
statement: Use the ambient proper/open calculus [lem-sf-ambient-proper-open-pasting] and the prescribed projections [def-exchange-projection]. TensorData records the actual tensor, proper projection pi and open tensor delta. Define compact(j,q)=J_j S_q, projection=pi followed by S_q(delta and inverse pullback compositor), alpha by whiskering the prescribed proper/open mate and applying the canonical proper and open compositors. Define trianglePull by inverse pullback composition and transport along bp=qi. leftMap and rightMap are the two displayed composites of the projection identity. TriangleLaws states invertibility, equality and joint naturality; Associativity states the three-cell 0F7K equation with endpoint transports. ordinaryTensor and realizedSystems/realizedTensor specialize this notation to finite coefficients and the specified integral systems. TriangleEquations records only the component equality. These are the existing component formulas, moved verbatim from the item, with no mathematical change.
